script_structures: Use a slow build with one big reveal near the very end.
Start in the middle of the action, then rewind to explain.
Contrast what you'd expect against what actually happened.
Open with a confession, then explain what led to it.
Walk through it in real time, like you're narrating it as it unfolds.
Frame it as a mystery, then solve it by the end.
